L1·N5378unmasked layer
This neuron's strongest (most negative) responses are on the newline/"#" token that starts a new paragraph right after a boilerplate closing line (e.g., "Thanks for subscribing!\n", "we promise.\n"), while its positive side fires on capitalized words that open a new segment or metadata label immediately after a sentence end ("Posted", "Examples", "Categories", "You", "can") — i.e., it tracks segment/paragraph-boundary tokens rather than any topic.

This neuron has no coherent semantic trigger — it peaks on ordinary high-frequency function tokens (pronouns "it"/"me", digits "1"/"0", "due", a name-suffix "alise") mid-sentence in informal prose, and the very same kinds of tokens ("it", "the", "0", "at") appear among its strongest suppressors, so it looks like a weak, polysemantic/noise-level unit rather than a feature detector.
